data.title: Solana or Ethereum: Which Is More Likely to Be a Millionaire-Maker by 2030?
data.description: Early Solana and Ethereum investors turned small bets into life-changing fortunes, but both coins now sit far below their peaks with ETF outflows mounting. The path to another millionaire-making run by 2030 requires clearing very different hurdles for each.
